definitions.gloss: business hotel; budget hotel; economy hotel
definitions.explanation: An affordable hotel with compact, functional rooms designed primarily for business travelers on short stays. A distinctly Japanese hotel category offering clean, no-frills accommodation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ビジネスホテル⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泊|と}まった→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: I stayed at a business hotel in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ビジネスホテル⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{安|やす}くて→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: Business hotels are cheap and convenient.

examples.english: I always book a business hotel for business trips, but recently they've become popular with foreign tourists too.

notes:
A Japanese-English compound (wasei-eigo influenced). Business hotels are a distinctly Japanese accommodation category: compact single rooms with bed, bath, TV, and Wi-Fi, typically near train stations. Major chains include {東横|とうよこ}イン, アパホテル, and ルートイン. They serve both business travelers and budget-conscious tourists.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ビジネスホテル⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泊|と}まる→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧: to stay at a business hotel
- ビジネスホテル⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}する→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧: to book a business hotel
- ⟦{格安|かくやす}→格安：15125_kakuyasu⟧ビジネスホテル: budget business hotel
- ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ビジネスホテル: business hotel near the station

SIMILAR WORDS:
- シティ⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧: city hotel — a larger, full-service hotel in an urban area
- ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧: ryokan, Japanese-style inn — traditional accommodation with tatami rooms and Japanese meals
- ⟦カプセルホテル→カプセルホテル：27577_kapuseruhoteru⟧: capsule hotel — even more compact and affordable, offering pod-style sleeping units
